_comment: The workflow's own vocabulary (spec 349): one source, read by core/scripts/aide-run-spec (jq) and by the dashboard (import). Readiness rules and how a setting is resolved stay out of this file on purpose — only plain lists belong here. workflowSteps: the names --command accepts. dependencyGatedSteps: the steps an unarchived dependency holds back — the ones that read or build on the code the dependency changes: analyze plans against that code, so a plan made before it lands is a plan for code about to change; create writes only the spec's own folder and needs nothing merged. workflowArc: the four stages a spec passes through, deliberately narrower than workflowSteps (explore is a thing you can queue, not a place a spec gets to). workflowArcRetired: a step name retired FROM the arc, kept recognized when reading old commits (review-plan folded into analyze).
